references.text: Psalm 73:23-26 speaks of God's presence and support through difficult times, which may reflect the sense of injustice and the burden felt by those who have worked all day in Matthew 20:12.
Isaiah 55:1 invites all who are thirsty to come to the water, which can be seen as an invitation to everyone, regardless of how long they have worked, like the last workers in Matthew 20:12.
Matthew 19:30, where Jesus says that many who are first will be last, and the last will be first, can be directly related to the situation in Matthew 20:12.
Matthew 20:16 repeats the idea that the first shall be last and the last first, which is a direct continuation of the thought from verse 12.
